text: 1.Above 18 years old, under 25 years old, good health2. Completion of high school or equivalent with a pass or above in all subjects on your transcript. Students who have not obtained a high school diploma are required to submit a pre-graduation certificate.3.Toefl 80 or above; Ielts 6.0 or above; Duolingo scores 100 or above; Or equivalent English proficiency certificate, such as EF4.If the previous study period was taught in Chinese or English, you can submit the corresponding teaching language proof, and the language achievement certificate is waived.
